segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: For the second in our series about locally-run businesses, we meet Simon Winridge, co-founder of the hugely-successful Winridge Forest Railway Park.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Welcome, Simon.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Now, perhaps you can begin by telling us a little bit about how it all started.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, during the 1970s, my wife, Liz and I had just acquired 80 acres of sheep-farming land, and we decided to settle down and have children.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Pretty soon we had a daughter, Sarah, and a son, Duncan.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: The place was wonderful for the kids: they particularly loved trains and gradually built up an enormous network of miniature railway track.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I began to develop larger-scale models of locomotives but we didn't think anything more of it until I went on a trip to a theme park near Birmingham and decided we could do a much better job! [[ ]] So we set up a small one ourselves based on the miniature railway and we opened to the public for just a month that year, 1984 - in July - our driest month - because our children said they didn't want our guests to have a miserable, wet visit. [[ ]] I dealt with Park business and Liz carried on with the farm work.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: It soon became clear that we were onto a winner.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We began to extend the railway track and lay it among more interesting landscape by planting trees, which in turn attracted more wildlife, and by making cuttings through the rock.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Nowadays, we're open all year round and we're pleased to say that Winridge is one of the most popular visitor attractions in the area - with 50,000 visitors a year - a million and a half people have been through our doors since we opened. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: All these visitors mean we have had to expand our operation and it's now a truly family concern.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I'm near to retirement age so I only concern myself with looking after the mechanical side of things [[ ]] - keeping the trains going.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Liz now devotes all her energies to recruiting and supporting the large squadron of workers, [[ ]] which keep the place running smoothly.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We're really pleased that after some years away teaching, Sarah has now returned to the park and makes sure the visitors are kept fed and watered, [[ ]] which keeps her pretty busy as you can imagine.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Our son, Duncan, has been a stalwart of the park for the last ten years, taking over from me in the area of construction [[ ]] - and I'll say a little bit more about that in a moment - and his new wife.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Judith, has also joined the team in charge of retail. [[ ]] That's becoming a tremendous growth area for us - a lot of people want to buy souvenirs.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: So have you finished your development of the site for the moment?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Not at all!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We're constantly looking for ways to offer more to our visitors.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: The railway remains the central feature and there's now 1.2 kilometres of the line laid but we'd like to lay more.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Because of the geology of the area, our greatest problem is digging tunnels.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: But we're gradually overcoming that.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We're also very pleased with a new installation of the Go-Kart arena which is 120 square metres in area. [[ ]] Again the problem is the geology; we had to level the mounds on the track for safety reasons.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We wanted to enable 5-12 year olds to use the go-karts. [[ ]] And the main attraction here is the Formula 1 Kart.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: We've known fights to break out over who gets it!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And then finally to our most recent development which is the landscaped...
